description: This file defines a static class 'NonCapturingTimer' that provides a wrapper around System.Threading.Timer to create timers that do not capture the ExecutionContext, helping to avoid rooting AsyncLocals during timer callbacks.

classes.name: NonCapturingTimer
classes.description: A static utility class providing a method to create timers that do not capture the ExecutionContext.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new Timer instance that suppresses capturing the ExecutionContext, accepting callback, state, dueTime, and period parameters.
